description: Source code implementing in-flight I/O handling for disk cache, including classes BackgroundIO and InFlightIO with methods for managing asynchronous I/O operations.

classes.name: BackgroundIO
classes.description: Represents background I/O operations with methods to signal completion, cancel, and clear controller.

classes.name: InFlightIO
classes.description: Manages in-flight I/O operations, including waiting for completion, dropping pending I/O, and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: BackgroundIO::OnIOSignalled
methods.description: Called when I/O is signaled; notifies the controller if present.

methods.name: BackgroundIO::Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the background I/O operation, potentially from another thread.

methods.name: InFlightIO::NotifyController
methods.description: Notifies the controller of I/O completion.

methods.name: InFlightIO::WaitForPendingIO
methods.description: Blocks until all pending I/O operations complete.

methods.name: InFlightIO::DropPendingIO
methods.description: Cancels and removes all pending I/O operations.

methods.name: InFlightIO::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an I/O operation, posting a signaled callback.

methods.name: InFlightIO::InvokeCallback
methods.description: Waits for I/O completion, optionally cancels, and invokes the callback.

methods.name: InFlightIO::OnOperationPosted
methods.description: Adds a new operation to the in-flight list.
